title: Mandarin Quest: The Seven-School Supper

locale.pinyinConvention: Conventional lexical third-tone spelling; contextual 一/不 tone changes are shown. Pinyin is assistance, not a phonetic trace.

provenance.notes: Original alpha teaching material; structural validation is not linguistic or acoustic validation. Ten-scene story revision: original fictional characters, listening-first teaching and optional character recognition. New Mandarin and synthesized audio await fluent-speaker editorial review.

roles.name: Guide · keeper of the gate
roles.description: Patient, dryly amused, and increasingly familiar with these two friends.

roles.name: Xiaolin · you
roles.description: Keeps the invitation safe and likes a clear plan. Bo is the one person who can turn that plan upside down.

roles.name: Bo · your friend
roles.description: An apprentice cook with enormous ambitions and a soft spot for hungry strangers. Usually helping someone; rarely where he promised to be.

scenes.title: The invitation
scenes.objective: Introduce yourself and ask who someone is.
scenes.setup: Lanterns hang above the gate. Xiaolin arrives for the supper of the seven sword schools with a carefully folded invitation. Bo promised to bring the entry bowls. Bo is missing.

grammarNote.title: Identity and possession
grammarNote.body: Use 是 between a person and an identity. 我的朋友 means my friend; changing 我 to 你 changes whose friend is meant.

scenes.resolution: The gatekeeper now knows whom Xiaolin is looking for. Beyond the gate, practice swords clack and cooking pots ring. Which sound has distracted Bo?

scenes.title: A cook in the crowd
scenes.objective: Ask about a person and their location.
scenes.setup: Xiaolin follows the gatekeeper into a street full of visiting sword students. Several wear hats almost as ridiculous as Bo’s.

grammarNote.title: Location and questions
grammarNote.body: 在这里 means be here. 吗 turns a statement into a yes/no question; 哪里 asks where. 不知道 means do not know.

scenes.resolution: No useful lead yet. A delicious smell drifts from the bridge. Xiaolin knows Bo well enough to suspect it.

scenes.title: The tempting shortcut
scenes.setup: Steam curls beyond the bridge. Xiaolin starts toward it; the gatekeeper calls out.

grammarNote.title: Instructions and plans
grammarNote.body: 去找他 means go look for him. 别走 tells someone not to leave. 我在这里等你 identifies who waits, where, and for whom.

scenes.resolution: Xiaolin agrees to wait. Then the gatekeeper speaks again from the roadside. Was that a new plan?

scenes.title: The noisy message
scenes.objective: Notice misunderstanding and ask for repetition.
scenes.setup: A practice gong sounds just as the gatekeeper gives an instruction. Xiaolin catches only part of it and nearly sets off again.

grammarNote.title: Understanding and repair
grammarNote.body: 听懂 combines hearing with the result of understanding. 没听懂 says that understanding did not happen. 请再说一遍 asks for another repetition.

scenes.resolution: This time Xiaolin stays put. The gatekeeper smiles at a tall cook’s hat bobbing through the crowd.

scenes.title: The wandering apprentice
scenes.objective: Recognize an arrival and make a group suggestion.
scenes.setup: The gatekeeper waves. Xiaolin turns toward the crowd one more time.

grammarNote.title: Arrival and suggestions
grammarNote.body: 他来了 announces an arrival here; 了 is not a general past-tense suffix. 我们一起走吧 proposes going together.

scenes.resolution: Together at last. Bo claims an apprentice must investigate every interesting smell. Xiaolin holds out a hand for a bowl. Bo hesitates: choosing which one is clearly important.

scenes.title: The two entry bowls
scenes.objective: Choose a bowl by listening for the object and its color.
scenes.setup: The invitation admits two guests, each carrying a colored bowl. Bo presents the bowls as though they are legendary treasures. Xiaolin would like to reach the kitchen.
scenes.resolution: With a bowl each, they set off. Bo announces through his posture that he knows the way. Xiaolin is unconvinced.

grammarNote.title: Naming and describing
grammarNote.body: 这是 introduces what something is. 这个 points to this one. 红色的 and 蓝色的 describe red and blue things; 我的 can stand for mine when the object is understood.

scenes.title: The confident wrong turn
scenes.objective: Distinguish directions and locations in spoken instructions.
scenes.setup: At the bridge, Bo points one way while watching steam rise in the other direction. Xiaolin folds their arms.
scenes.resolution: Across the bridge, Xiaolin checks the invitation. Bo checks his hands. One of the bowls is missing.

grammarNote.title: Directions and landmarks
grammarNote.body: 左边 and 右边 identify sides. 这里 is here; 那里 is there. Keep listening after 在 to find the place.

scenes.title: An empty hand
scenes.objective: Hear who has something and whether it is inside or outside.
scenes.setup: Bo stares at his empty hand. Xiaolin recognizes this expression from several previous adventures. They check what they still have.
scenes.resolution: No bowl. Then Bo remembers giving it to a hungry traveler near the gate. Xiaolin looks at the invitation: the supper requires two bowls. Back they go.

grammarNote.title: Having and locating
grammarNote.body: 有 means have or there is; 没有 negates it. 里面 and 外面 locate things inside and outside. Listen for 没有 rather than assuming the object is present.

scenes.title: A better kind of hero
scenes.objective: Ask for help and recognize giving, thanks, and an apology.
scenes.setup: The gatekeeper sees them returning and raises an eyebrow. Bo finally stops pretending that everything is going to plan.
scenes.resolution: The bowl comes back. Xiaolin is still annoyed, but understands why Bo stopped: he fed someone. The gatekeeper points them toward the kitchen. Bo offers to wait while Xiaolin checks the route.

grammarNote.title: Who helps whom?
grammarNote.body: In 我帮你找, I help you look. In 我给你这个, I give this to you. Listen to the people on both sides of 帮 or 给.

scenes.title: A place at the table
scenes.objective: Recognize noodles, the start of an action, flavor, and a plan for tomorrow.
scenes.setup: They reach the kitchen with both bowls. The seven schools’ guests are waiting. The gatekeeper has mentioned Bo’s kindness to the cooks, and an extra place is offered beside the noodle pot.
scenes.resolution: The bowls are empty again, for a much better reason. Tomorrow they will meet at the gate. A cook slips a folded recipe beside Bo’s bowl, sealed with a small sword-shaped mark. This time, Bo shows Xiaolin before going anywhere.

grammarNote.title: Food and a new plan
grammarNote.body: 面条 means noodles; 吃 means eat. 开始 means start. 很好吃 describes food as tasty. 明天 sets a plan tomorrow; compare it with 现在, now.

nodes.title: First exchange
nodes.storyBeat: Lanterns hang above the gate. Xiaolin arrives for the supper of the seven sword schools with a carefully folded invitation. Bo promised to bring the entry bowls. Bo is missing.

nodes.title: Use it in context
nodes.storyBeat: Xiaolin shows the gatekeeper a sketch of Bo: an apprentice cook with a very large hat and an even larger ambition.

nodes.title: First exchange
nodes.storyBeat: Xiaolin follows the gatekeeper into a street full of visiting sword students. Several wear hats almost as ridiculous as Bo’s.

nodes.title: Use it in context
nodes.storyBeat: Pointing at every hat is not helping. Xiaolin tries asking about the missing friend instead.

nodes.title: First exchange
nodes.storyBeat: Steam curls beyond the bridge. Xiaolin starts toward it; the gatekeeper calls out.

nodes.title: Use it in context
nodes.storyBeat: The gatekeeper raises one finger. Xiaolin wonders how a person can be asked to wait when their friend may already be tasting everything.

nodes.title: First exchange
nodes.storyBeat: A practice gong sounds just as the gatekeeper gives an instruction. Xiaolin catches only part of it and nearly sets off again.

nodes.title: Use it in context
nodes.storyBeat: Xiaolin asks for another try. A swordsman nearby repeats a graceful movement; the gatekeeper repeats a much simpler instruction.

nodes.title: First exchange
nodes.storyBeat: The gatekeeper waves. Xiaolin turns toward the crowd one more time.

nodes.title: Use it in context
nodes.storyBeat: Bo appears with two entry bowls. He has been looking for Xiaolin too. The gatekeeper studies the sky, apparently hiding a smile.

nodes.title: What are you holding?
nodes.storyBeat: The invitation admits two guests, each carrying a colored bowl. Bo presents the bowls as though they are legendary treasures. Xiaolin would like to reach the kitchen.

nodes.title: Choose by color
nodes.storyBeat: Bo keeps swapping the bowls between his hands. Xiaolin tries describing the one they mean.

nodes.title: Which way?
nodes.storyBeat: At the bridge, Bo points one way while watching steam rise in the other direction. Xiaolin folds their arms.

nodes.title: Use a landmark
nodes.storyBeat: The bridge should make a good landmark. Bo would be more convincing if his pointing hand stayed still.

nodes.title: Check what remains
nodes.storyBeat: Bo stares at his empty hand. Xiaolin recognizes this expression from several previous adventures. They check what they still have.

nodes.title: Look around the shelter
nodes.storyBeat: They search a roadside shelter where visiting sword students leave their packs. Bo peers through the doorway; Xiaolin looks around it.

nodes.title: Ask instead of guessing
nodes.storyBeat: The gatekeeper sees them returning and raises an eyebrow. Bo finally stops pretending that everything is going to plan.

nodes.title: An awkward thank-you
nodes.storyBeat: The traveler has finished eating and left the bowl with the gatekeeper. Bo studies his shoes while Xiaolin asks for it.

nodes.title: At the noodle pot
nodes.storyBeat: They reach the kitchen with both bowls. The seven schools’ guests are waiting. The gatekeeper has mentioned Bo’s kindness to the cooks, and an extra place is offered beside the noodle pot.

nodes.title: A new promise
nodes.storyBeat: The supper begins. Bo watches every movement of the cooks; Xiaolin finally gets to sit down. Between mouthfuls, the friends start another plan.

constructionExercises.explanation: 我们 names the group; 一起 says together; 走吧 proposes going.

checkpointExercises.question: Whose friend is the speaker?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 他的朋友 means his friend; 我 identifies the speaker as that friend.

checkpointExercises.question: What is being asked?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 他是你的朋友吗 asks about his relationship to you.

checkpointExercises.question: Is he here?

options.label: The speaker is asking, not saying.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 不在这里 means not here.

checkpointExercises.question: Does the speaker know his location?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 知道 is positive here: I know. Compare 不知道.

checkpointExercises.question: What are you told not to do?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 别 negates the instruction 在这里等我: wait here for me.

checkpointExercises.question: What will the group do?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 我们一起去找他 combines we, together, go, and look for him.

checkpointExercises.question: What should you do?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 请 makes the familiar 等一下 request polite.

checkpointExercises.question: Did the speaker see him?

options.label: The speaker asks whether you saw him.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 没看见 negates seeing him; it is not the positive 看见…了.

checkpointExercises.question: Who understood?

options.label: The speaker did, but he did not.
He did, but the speaker did not.

checkpointExercises.explanation: The first clause is positive 听懂了; the second is negative 没听懂.

checkpointExercises.question: What is proposed after his arrival?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 他来了 announces arrival, then 我们走吧 proposes leaving.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 蓝色的碗是我的。 — The blue bowl is mine.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 他在桥的右边。 — He is to the right of the bridge.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?

options.label: Your friend waits for me outside.
Your friend waits for me inside.
My friend waits for you outside.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 你的朋友在外面等我。 — Your friend is waiting for me outside.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?

options.label: I do not have a red bowl.
I do not have a blue bowl.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 我没有红色的碗。 — I do not have a red bowl.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?

options.label: Help him find the blue bowl.
Help me find the blue bowl.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 请帮他找蓝色的碗。 — Please help him find the blue bowl.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 我明天给你这个。 — I will give you this tomorrow.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?

options.label: Thanks for waiting for me here.
Sorry for waiting for you here.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 谢谢你在这里等我。 — Thank you for waiting for me here.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?

options.label: He has noodles; let us start.
He has a bowl; let us leave.
He has noodles; let us wait.

checkpointExercises.explanation: 他有面条，我们开始吧。 — He has noodles; let us start.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 里面的面条很好吃。 — The noodles inside are tasty.

checkpointExercises.question: Which meaning matches what you heard?
checkpointExercises.explanation: 明天我们一起去那里吧。 — Let us go there together tomorrow.

audioPolicy.roleMapping: One verified Mandarin narrator may read all roles in the AWS-only alpha. Do not claim independent voices.

sfx.purpose: A quiet tactile confirmation on button press.
Positive feedback after the spoken prompt ends.
Gentle neutral feedback; no harsh failure alarm.
Brief completion cue after all speech stops.

synopsis: Seven sword schools are gathering for a festival supper. Xiaolin has the invitation and a careful plan. Bo, an apprentice cook, has the two entry bowls and a habit of helping strangers. Play as Xiaolin: find your friend, reach the kitchen, and discover why a simple supper has everyone so excited.
